metadata.query: How do I cut off the heads of some fish I am cooking?

final_answer: To remove the heads of fish for cooking, hold the fish firmly with one hand and use a sharp knife in the other. Make a cut along the spine from the bottom of the neck to just behind the gills. Then, apply pressure on the head and twist it off. Be careful not to cut too deep or you may damage the flesh. [Cited sources: url1 and url2]
